name: jabworks-agentic-toolkit
description: Hieu Vi's personal Claude Code toolkit: session handoff, plugin scaffolding, and stack-specific skill adapting.

plugins.name: session-handoff
plugins.description: Creates and resumes handoff documents for seamless Claude Code session transitions. Use when context window approaches capacity or a work session is ending.

plugins.name: plugin-foundry
plugins.description: Create and maintain skills in jabworks/agentic-toolkit: scaffold, register in marketplace, sync dist mirror, and publish.

plugins.name: adapting-skills
plugins.description: Use when adapting a generic skill or scaffolding code to match Harvey's stack, conventions, and working preferences.

plugins.name: session-report
plugins.description: Generate an explorable HTML report of session usage — tokens, cache, subagents, skills, expensive prompts. Works for Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: condux
plugins.description: Lean agentic workflow skills: tiered task routing, brainstorm gate, lean planning, opt-in TDD, subagent coordination, end-of-task quality gate, on-request code review, done-check verification, and root-cause-first debugging.
